bio:
"Mr. Conway" is a placeholder name drawn directly from a victim/plaintiff journal in the Doe v. Black litigation (1:23-cv-06418 / 1:22-cv-10019) contained in the DOJ EFTA release — the same journal, and the same passage, that produced this platform's Mr. Rails, Mr. Ein, Mr. Jacobson, Mr. Vradenberg, and Bill S. entity records. The passage (EFTA02731465 p.5, Bates EFTA02731470, duplicated at EFTA00155037 p.14, Bates EFTA00155049, Dataset 8) reads: "...Mr. Rails and Mr. Ein [clipping: blood on their hands] but so does Jeffrey and Mr. Jacobson. Mr. Conway Mr. vradenberg and Bill s. All of them who dont care if this happens!" It directly follows a passage describing "Mr. Leonsis" bringing "a friend" to "make a video" during a described abusive "procedure." Read grammatically, "Mr. Conway" is grouped with Jeffrey, Jacobson, Vradenberg, and Bill S. as someone accused of not caring that the abuse was happening — an awareness/indifference allegation, distinct from the separate clause accusing only Rails and Ein of having "blood on their hands."

No first name accompanies "Mr. Conway" in the journal. A probable — not confirmed — real-world identification points to John Horton Conway (1937–2020), the Princeton University professor of mathematics famous for inventing the "Game of Life" cellular automaton, group theory's Conway groups, and surreal numbers. "John Conway" appears by full name across at least 64 corpus documents (65 pages, all Dataset 11), the large majority being duplicate or near-duplicate guest lists for an Epstein-hosted science-salon dinner alongside figures such as Gerald Sussman, Stephen Wolfram, Murray Gell-Mann, and Persi Diaconis. The clearest identifying document is a 10/20/2010 email exchange in which Epstein's event organizer Al Seckel proposes adding "my good friend John Conway, who is a professor of mathematics at Princeton, super fun, and definitely one of the best mathematicians on this planet" to a dinner guest list (EFTA01981940), then separately asks Epstein directly, "Do you know John Conway? He is pretty incredible...." (EFTA02418240). "John Conway" then recurs on well over a dozen duplicate guest-list emails for the same or related events through the early-to-mid 2010s (e.g. EFTA01780852, EFTA01991184, EFTA01827309).

Caution: a separate "John Conway and his team" appears in unrelated 2012 hospitality-reservation emails for Epstein's stays at The Cove, Atlantis Paradise Island, Nassau (EFTA02012930 and near-duplicates EFTA02023661, EFTA02030183, EFTA01768270), routed through Atlantis executive Alan Leibman and Dubai World chairman Sultan Bin Sulayem. In context ("...and John Conway and his team will make sure they have a great stay!") this reads as an Atlantis resort staff contact arranging Epstein's room reservation, not the mathematician, and should not be conflated with the science-salon guest-list "John Conway." Corpus-wide, the bare surname "Conway" returns 325 documents / 479 pages — not diagnostic on its own.

The identification is probable, not confirmed, held to the same evidentiary caution this platform applied after the 2026-09-16 correction of the "Mr. Vradenberg"/George Vradenburg III record: it rests on a bare surname match in the journal plus circumstantial (if well-documented) social-circle proximity, not on a first name stated in the journal itself. A web search for "John Horton Conway" and "Jeffrey Epstein" together returns no independent public reporting connecting the two — this is a corpus-only finding. John Horton Conway died April 11, 2020, in Princeton, New Jersey, of complications from COVID-19 compounded by vascular dementia, at age 82 — before the EFTA disclosures existed and with no public reporting ever raising this allegation against him. He was never charged, sued, or publicly investigated in connection with Jeffrey Epstein.
tier_justification: T3 (Circumstantial): Named in a victim/plaintiff journal passage (EFTA02731465 p.5 / EFTA00155037 p.14) alongside Rails, Ein, Jacobson, Vradenberg, and Bill S. as one of several people accused of not caring that ongoing abuse was happening -- an awareness/indifference allegation, not the separate 'blood on their hands' direct-perpetration clause that names only Rails and Ein in the same sentence. The journal itself gives no first name, title, or other identifying detail. A probable-not-confirmed identification (same evidentiary posture as this journal's Mr. Ein and Bill S. sibling records) points to John Horton Conway, Princeton mathematics professor (1937-2020), based on his repeated, well-documented presence across dozens of Epstein's own science-salon guest-list emails (Dataset 11) and a direct 10/20/2010 email describing him as event organizer Al Seckel's 'good friend...professor of mathematics at Princeton' (EFTA01981940/EFTA02418240). This rests on a bare surname match plus circumstantial social-circle proximity, not a first-name match in the journal itself -- and a separate, likely-unrelated 'John Conway' (an Atlantis resort staff contact in 2012 hospitality emails) also appears in the corpus, raising a namesake risk. Held to the same caution the 2026-09-16 Vradenburg correction established. NOT publish-ready.
evidence_summary:
• Journal origin: EFTA02731465 p.5 (Bates EFTA02731470) / duplicate EFTA00155037 p.14 (Bates EFTA00155049, Dataset 8) -- "...Mr. Rails and Mr. Ein [clipping: blood on their hands] but so does Jeffrey and Mr. Jacobson. Mr. Conway Mr. vradenberg and Bill s. All of them who dont care if this happens!"
• Allegation category: awareness/indifference to ongoing abuse, not direct-perpetration -- contrast with the separate p.2 passage ("Disgusting pigs like Allen Douschewitz and Mr. Caruthers and even Mr. Islam will hurt you...") naming a different trio in a direct-abuse framing.
• Data-integrity fix: prior record's source_docs cited EFTA02731420; full-text review of all 12 pages of that document found no mention of "Conway" in any form. Citation removed; corrected source_docs are EFTA02731465 and EFTA00155037 only (same false-citation pattern already found and fixed on the Caruthers, Islam, and Rails sibling records).
• Data-integrity fix: the one pre-existing entity_documents link (a fuzzy match on "M. Conway" inside an unrelated academic citation -- "Howe & M. Conway (Chairs), Memory & the law" -- in a document about eyewitness memory research) was a false positive and has been removed.
• Probable identification: John Horton Conway (1937-2020), Princeton University professor of mathematics, appears by full name across 64 corpus documents / 65 pages (all Dataset 11), the large majority duplicate/near-duplicate guest-list emails for an Epstein-hosted science-salon dinner alongside Gerald Sussman, Stephen Wolfram, Murray Gell-Mann, Persi Diaconis, and others.
• Key identification document: EFTA01981940 (10/20/2010, Al Seckel to Jeffrey Epstein): "Would you object to my replacing him with my good friend John Conway, who is a professor of mathematics at Princeton, super fun, and definitely one of the best mathematicians on this planet." Follow-up in the same thread, EFTA02418240: "Do you know John Conway? He is pretty incredible...."
• Caution -- namesake risk: a separate, likely-unrelated "John Conway and his team" appears in 2012 Atlantis Paradise Island (Nassau) hospitality-reservation emails (EFTA02012930 + near-duplicates EFTA02023661, EFTA02030183, EFTA01768270) routed through Atlantis executive Alan Leibman and Dubai World chairman Sultan Bin Sulayem -- reads as resort staff arranging Epstein's room reservation, not the mathematician. Flagged so the two are not conflated in any future work on this record.
• Real-world corroboration check: web search for "John Horton Conway" + "Jeffrey Epstein" returns no independent public reporting connecting the two as of this session -- this is a corpus-only finding.
• Status: John Horton Conway died April 11, 2020, in Princeton, NJ, of complications from COVID-19 compounded by vascular dementia, age 82 -- before the EFTA disclosures existed; never publicly investigated, charged, or named in connection with Epstein.
• Standing court order: Judge Clarke ordered third-party names in this journal redacted going forward (1:23-cv-06418, ECF 388) -- same restriction applies to this record as to its sibling entities from the same journal.
• Tier justification: T3 (Circumstantial) -- documentary/testimonial evidence of an allegation exists, but the accused person's real-world identity is not established from the journal itself. NOT publish-ready; no profile_published/is_public/user_confirmed change made.
